name: Poimandres

VINIT.justification: The unmanifest state of the abyss before the appearance of the Light.

TANCH.justification: The final boundary of the cosmos where the soul returns to the Father.

AFWD.justification: The forward movement of the Word into the moist nature to create the world.

AREV.justification: The reverse movement through the seven planetary spheres to shed material qualities.

CLINK.justification: The sequential linking of the seven governors to the material creation.

IMSCRIB.justification: The archetypal human who recognizes his own divine nature as Light and Life.

FSPLIT.chosen_element: The Division of the Androgynous Man
FSPLIT.justification: The primordial human splits into male and female biological forms.

FFUSE.justification: The reunification of the divided human into the singular divine essence.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative recognition of the divine origin.

EVALF.justification: The failure to recognize the self, leading to death and darkness.

ENGAGR.justification: The human condition of being simultaneously mortal in body and immortal in essence.

IFIX.justification: The permanent fixation of the law of return and the fate of the soul.

phase_2.split_element: The Division of the Androgynous Man

phase_3.void_description: The chaotic abyss before the Light of Nous appears.
phase_3.true_description: The state of the soul that has attained Gnosis and returns to the Father.
phase_3.false_description: The state of the soul trapped in the darkness of the material senses.
phase_3.both_description: The incarnate human who is both the son of God and a slave to the spheres.

steps.domain_action: The abyss exists as an unformed potentiality before the vision.
Poimandres reveals himself as the Mind of Sovereignty.
The Holy Word leaps from the elements of nature to the Demiurge.
The Demiurge creates the seven governors to encompass the world.
The Father begets the Anthropos, equal to himself.
The Anthropos breaks through the spheres and falls into nature.
The Anthropos becomes dual, mortal because of body and immortal because of essence.
The soul that loves the body remains in the darkness of the senses.
The soul that knows itself begins the ascent through the seven zones.
The soul reaches the eighth sphere and sings hymns to the Father.
The soul enters into God, becoming the very power it sought.
The vision ends and Hermes records the teaching for humanity.
The system closes as the soul is absorbed into the One.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Logos which translates the Mind of God into the structure of the cosmos.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The resonance between the macrocosm of the spheres and the microcosm of the human soul.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The seven planetary zones which store the qualities and vices of the soul.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The Providence and Necessity that govern the timing of birth and death.
phase_5.alfs_store: The Divine Nous which contains the archetypal forms of all things.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The shedding of the seven material garments during the ascent.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: The soul is scattered and bound within the material elements.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: The soul is unified and restored to its original divine state.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The system is a closed cycle where the soul returns to its point of origin without loss of essence.
